entity_type: Fictional creature — D&D SRD humanoid (stat block)
origin:
Medium humanoid in the D&D 5e SRD bestiary (challenge rating 2, any non-lawful alignment). It takes a strong personality, ruthless cunning, and a silver tongue to keep a gang of bandits in line. The **bandit captain** has these qualities in spades.

In addition to managing a crew of selfish malcontents, the **pirate captain** is a variation of the bandit captain, with a ship to protect and command. To keep the crew in line, the captain must mete out rewards and punishment on a regular basis.

More than treasure, a bandit captain or pirate captain craves infamy. A prisoner who appeals to the captain’s vanity or ego is more likely to be treated fairly than a prisoner who does not or claims not to know anything of the captain’s colorful reputation.

personality.mbti_label: Lore-based interpretive read (fan interpretation) — a behaviour-design lens, not a measurement.
personality.justification: Neutral evil giant, INT 9/WIS 10/CHA 12: a giant of the ordning, proud, rank-conscious and long-memoried; the pattern — extraverted force of presence, concrete, sense-first thinking, logic over feeling, and an improvising, open-ended style — reads as ESTP.

behavior_model: Acts from its alignment and type drives: a giant of the ordning, proud, rank-conscious and long-memoried. Reaches first for Multiattack, Greataxe, Rock; escalates or withdraws as hit points, territory and pride dictate. State changes: provoked, curious, bargaining, fleeing, triumphant.
relationships: Ranked in the ordning among giantkind; smaller peoples are servants, livestock or vermin depending on the giant's type and mood.
memory_model: With INT 9, memory is patchy — strong on threat and food, weak on names and sequence. It misreads what its alignment expects it to misread.
confidence_and_conflicts: Stat-derived lean record; the SRD gives mechanics, not biography — temperament read from alignment/type/abilities only.
game_implementation: BrainKit runs it as a stat-derived agent: drives and region weights above gate its action list, with the INT band capping planning depth — no biography-driven behaviour is simulated.
